description: The complete pass over the shipped account master. app/data/ASCII/acctdata.txt holds exactly 50 records of 300 bytes, and app/cbl/CBACT01C.cbl:L70-L87 displays each one TWICE - 1100-DISPLAY-ACCT-RECORD emits eleven labelled field lines plus a 49-dash separator from inside the '00' arm of the read paragraph at L96, and the mainline's DISPLAY ACCOUNT-RECORD at L78 emits the raw 300-byte image - so the run emits 1 + (50 x 13) + 1 = 652 lines and ends with RETURN-CODE 0. Every one of the 50 rows is pinned byte for byte on the final-state channel, which is how this case asserts that a program named AccountBalanceJob updates nothing at all.
